title: Tour: hmrscience.life
intro: A short look at hmrscience.life in screenshots of the site itself, with our own words for each one. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

steps.say: Screenshots only, nothing is sent. HMR does not say believe this. It lays out a chain you can inspect and labels every claim, so a skeptic only has to find the link that breaks.
Each claim is marked once, where it is made, as established science, HMR's view, or open. Established science carries a source link. Open means we do not know yet.

It tells one narrative that never breaks logic, from a non-physical intelligence to the physical universe. It does not prove that Universal Intelligence exists, replace established physics, or yet derive gravity.
